text: : Segment limits are capped at 500 each via `SEMANTIC_MAX_SEGMENTS`, but the **product** (250,000 pairs) has no limit. The `token_overlap` and `tfidf` backends iterate all N×M pairs. At 500×500 = 250k iterations, this produces a ~2MB+ response and seconds of CPU time. The Groq backend limits to 20 pairs, but other backends do not.
